capabilities: Toggle checkboxes inside Markdown tables in Reading Mode
Save checkbox state changes to the Markdown file
Support multiple checkboxes per cell and per row
Decorate and toggle checkboxes directly in the editor via CodeMirror
problem: Obsidian tables show checkboxes as static text in Reading Mode, so they cannot be toggled without editing the source.
summary: Renders checkboxes inside Markdown tables as interactive toggles that update the underlying Markdown file when clicked.
